defects: The curved rocker rails visually float slightly above the floor; the measured asset minimum Y is 0.542 inches.
A separate RoomDefinition computer tower sits on the chair and remains visible beside or behind it in the production captures.
incumbent_comparison: The first technically valid candidate has a recognizable slatted rocker form and the corrected full-length rails, but a measured lower rail bound remains about 0.54 inches above the floor.
likely_causes: The rocker curve centerline is offset too high relative to the rail radius.
The room's computer-on-chair object is an independent gameplay prop, not part of the generated chair.
next_action_hypothesis: Lower the rocker centerline by about half an inch to bring its lower rail surface to floor contact, keep the same camera focus behind the occupied seat, and revalidate bounds and visibility.
